flashcard_questions.q: What is footfall for a retail business?
flashcard_questions.a: The number of people walking past or through a location.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the cluster concept in business location?
flashcard_questions.a: Businesses in the same industry group together in one area to attract more customers.
A product that is smaller or lighter than the raw materials used to make it.

flashcard_questions.q: Why is Denby Pottery based in Denby, Derbyshire?
flashcard_questions.a: A large seam of high-quality clay was discovered there.
The buying and selling of products and services over electronic networks such as the internet.
Using several different selling methods, for example a website, a shop and wholesalers.

flashcard_questions.q: A balanced marketing mix means all ____ fit the same target market.
Which element of the marketing mix covers how the product reaches the customer?

flashcard_questions.a: Making a product stand out from competitors through unique features, quality or branding.

flashcard_questions.q: Which cosmetics brand sells unique, higher-priced products to a niche market?
Which discount retailer sells mass market products at low prices?
Which car manufacturer built a factory in Derby where government grants were available?
What is the main drawback of running an online-only business?
flashcard_questions.a: It is hidden, so customers may not discover it without effective promotion.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the drawback of locating close to competitors?
flashcard_questions.a: It can lead to price wars and reduced profit margins.

flashcard_questions.q: Why might a business locate in an area of high unemployment?
flashcard_questions.a: To access a large pool of applicants and keep wage costs lower.
